highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds platform API coverage and hardens the shipped native binaries.
highlights_body: This servicing release restores missing tvOS surface overloads, preserves Android symbols, and enables modern Windows and Linux binary mitigations.

bullets.detail: tvOS applications can use the same SKSurface.Create overload coverage as the related Apple targets.
Android native symbols are retained and packaged for improved diagnostics of native crashes.
Windows and Linux native libraries are built with additional control-flow and buffer-protection mitigations.

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added the Linux native binary mitigation.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 enabled Windows native binary mitigations.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 added tvOS surface overloads and Android symbol packaging.

harfbuzz_summary: Ships the synchronized HarfBuzzSharp package with the native binary hardening and Android symbol packaging updates.
